card.name: Century digit in political history years
card.fires_on: The second digit of a four-year number (7, 8, 9, or 1) right after an initial 1, in dates of political office, coalitions, ministers or rulers. It is mostly 18th and 19th century years.

modes.label: Years of ministers and statesmen
modes.description: The digit after 1 in a year within a statesman's term of office.

modes.label: Years of coalitions and governments
modes.description: The digit after 1 in a year for a party, coalition or government event.

card.writes: It suppresses words about politicians, officials and elected office, so it pushes against more political-role words after the year.
card.plain: It marks the start of a year, as the model reads a date in the history of a government or a political career.
